cohort: Participants were people who initiated breastfeeding after delivery between December 2022 and May 2023 at two hospitals in New York.
finding: The incidence of Dysphoric Milk Ejection Reflex (DMER) was found to be 26.9%, with most symptoms being very mild to moderate.
mod_finding: Participants with DMER had a significantly higher rate of having delivered via cesarean section (71.4% vs. 33.3%) compared to those without DMER.
